_comment: Vision candidates for the OCR/import role. Every file name and byte size below was read off the HuggingFace API on 2026-09-09, because a catalog entry pointing at a file that does not exist can never download and never fails loudly. Reference it from vision.json as {"use": "<name>"}.
_gb: Download total: weights + projector, decimal GB. The phone tiers use the app's rule of thumb that resident RAM tracks the on-disk total, so a device wants roughly 6x this free.
_mode: "pairs" = an instruction-following VLM, asked for the JSON array directly. "transcribe" = a document/OCR model whose output is markup or plain text, so it needs a second pass to turn a page into pairs (vision.json's pairWith).

phone-max.label: Fits a mid/high tier phone (<= 1.3 GB)

borderline.label: Tablet only, close enough to be tempting

lab.label: PC only - answers 'does size fix it?'

smolvlm-256m.note: the shipped LOW rung. SmolLM2-135M backbone

smolvlm2-256m.note: same size as the shipped one, one generation newer

smolvlm-500m.note: 2x the backbone of the 256M for 2x the download

lfm2vl-450m.note: same family as the shipped text models, built for on-device. LFM Open License, not Apache

granite-docling-258m.note: document specialist, emits DocTags - tables come out as structure, not prose. No quantized build published

internvl3-1b.note: strong OCR for the size in InternVL's own evals. No Q4 build published

lightonocr-1b.note: OCR specialist, markdown out. Distilled for page transcription only

lfm2vl-1.6b.note: the projector is 538 MB of the total - bigger than most models here on its own

minicpm-v-4.6.note: MiniCPM-V is document-strong; verify what this build actually is, the Q4 weights are far smaller than the model card implies

nanonets-ocr2-1.5b.note: OCR specialist tuned for documents and tables. Community quant, marked experimental upstream

qwen3-vl-2b.note: the strongest small VLM on OCR benchmarks; the one to beat

granite-vision-3.3-2b.note: trained heavily on documents, unlike the general VLMs

dots-ocr.note: layout-aware document parser, JSON out. The upper bound for OCR quality at this size

qwen2.5-vl-7b.note: the ceiling row: what a cloud backend would give us

_not_packaged: PaddleOCR-VL 0.9B/1.6 and Nanonets-OCR-s look attractive on paper but have no usable llama.cpp pair on HuggingFace: PaddlePaddle's own GGUF repo publishes the projector without the language model, and Nanonets-OCR-s only exists at 3B+. Re-check if either lands a complete build.
